title: Shiekh Shoes
slugLine: A break-even analysis of the Shiekh Shoes store at USC Village, with a campus-first plan to sell enough pairs sooner.

research.problem: The USC Village store needs to sell ==8,560 pairs of shoes a year== to cover its overheads and stock, **but sells an estimated 7,200**.

stakeholders.name: Shiekh Shoes, LLC
stakeholders.note: California footwear retailer founded in 1991, with 135 US stores and an online store

painPoints.label: High fixed costs
painPoints.detail: Rent ($200,000), labor ($180,000), utilities ($24,000) and marketing ($24,000) add up to $428,000 a year.

painPoints.label: Half of every sale goes to stock
painPoints.detail: A pair sells for about $100 and costs about $50 wholesale, so each pair leaves $50 toward overheads.

painPoints.label: A sales gap
painPoints.detail: At an estimated 7,200 pairs a year, the store sells 1,360 fewer than it needs to break even.

insights.evidence: Athletic, streetwear and fashion-forward segments are growing the fastest.

insights.insight: A college town brings its own customers
insights.evidence: Each new class of students creates an influx of new customers without any need for marketing.
Shiekh-branded shoes and merchandise carry higher margins and lower COGS.

design.lead: The strategy sells to the campus on the store’s doorstep: ads within three miles of USC, student reps and influencers, limited drops and in-store events, and referral codes that turn each customer into the reason a friend visits.

blocks.title: Marketing and promotions
items: Referral codes that give a customer and their friends a discount on the next visit, which brings two purchases and hands customer acquisition to the customers themselves
Local influencer partnerships with USC students, campus athletes and micro-influencers
Limited drops and streetwear collabs, such as a Shiekh-exclusive Banksy × Nike, launched social-first
In-store activations: sneaker culture nights, DJ sets and giveaways

blocks.title: Digital and social
items: Geo-targeted Instagram and TikTok ads within a 3-mile radius of USC
A campus reps program: ambassadors who post and drive traffic

blocks.title: Merchandising
items: Sync inventory with e-commerce to offer local store pickup

results.lead: Selling ==8,560 pairs a year== breaks the store even. At 10% growth a year it gets there in late 2026; at 5%, in mid-2028.

blocks.title: Fixed costs
blocks.note: Rent is the average for commercial space in South Central Los Angeles; utilities are the Los Angeles average for 4,000 sq ft; marketing is the average across Shiekh stores.
